race.comment: BURN THE SKY (6) was sent out a $2.60 favourite at her last start over this course and distance but wasn't ridden out when it was feared she was injured. The run prior to that was a promising second-up performance here over the mile. Trialled satisfactorily and is ready to pick up the pieces. LEICA STORM (2) led and gave a sight but found one a little better two back over 1800m at the Kensington circuit. Didn't run a strong 1900m at Newcastle last start. Worth another chance. NAINA (3) is a consistent mare but finds it hard to win. Came home with a wet sail to get up for fourth last time out over 1400m at this track. Has a strong record at the mile and J Mac going on doesn't harm her chances. CHILLI MARGS (7) raced wide without cover and died on her run when second-up over 1400m here recently. Fitter now and not out of the contest. SNEAKY CHOICE (11) is racing well without winning and is worth throwing in the exotics.
